title: calonemorchis discoidea
intro: Calonemorchis discoidea, commonly known as the Disco Orchid, is a species of orchid native to Southeast Asia. This plant is used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving respiratory health, and aiding in the treatment of fever and cough. The therapeutic actions of Calonemorchis discoidea include its antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
